name: Glaceon
flavorText: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.
howToObtain: Breed from its evolution at the Solaceon Day Care or transfer via Pal Park

levelUp.name: Tail Whip
levelUp.description: The user wags its tail cutely, making the foe less wary. The target’s Defense stat is lowered.

levelUp.name: Tackle
levelUp.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the foe with its whole body.

levelUp.name: Helping Hand
levelUp.description: A move that boosts the power of the ally’s attack in a Double Battle.

levelUp.name: Baton Pass
levelUp.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, passing along any stat changes.

levelUp.name: Sand-Attack
levelUp.description: Sand is hurled in the foe’s face, reducing its accuracy.

levelUp.name: Icy Wind
levelUp.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

levelUp.name: Quick Attack
levelUp.description: The user lunges at the foe at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.

levelUp.name: Bite
levelUp.description: The foe is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. It may make the target flinch.

levelUp.name: Ice Shard
levelUp.description: The user flash freezes chunks of ice and hurls them. This move always goes first.

levelUp.name: Ice Fang
levelUp.description: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or freeze.

levelUp.name: Mirror Coat
levelUp.description: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

levelUp.name: Blizzard
levelUp.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the foe. It may also freeze the target solid.

levelUp.name: Hail
levelUp.description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.

levelUp.name: Barrier
levelUp.description: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.

levelUp.name: Last Resort
levelUp.description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

tmHm.name: Water Pulse
tmHm.description: The user attacks the foe with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the foe.

tmHm.name: Roar
tmHm.description: The foe is scared off, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

tmHm.name: Toxic
tmHm.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

tmHm.name: Hail
tmHm.description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.

tmHm.name: Hidden Power
tmHm.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

tmHm.name: Sunny Day
tmHm.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

tmHm.name: Ice Beam
tmHm.description: The foe is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

tmHm.name: Blizzard
tmHm.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the foe. It may also freeze the target solid.

tmHm.name: Hyper Beam
tmHm.description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

tmHm.name: Protect
tmHm.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tmHm.name: Rain Dance
tmHm.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water- type moves.

tmHm.name: Frustration
tmHm.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

tmHm.name: Iron Tail
tmHm.description: The foe is slammed with a steel-hard tail. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

tmHm.name: Return
tmHm.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

tmHm.name: Dig
tmHm.description: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

tmHm.name: Shadow Ball
tmHm.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the foe. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

tmHm.name: Double Team
tmHm.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

tmHm.name: Facade
tmHm.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

tmHm.name: Secret Power
tmHm.description: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

tmHm.name: Rest
tmHm.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

tmHm.name: Attract
tmHm.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

tmHm.name: Endure
tmHm.description: The user endures any attack, leaving 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tmHm.name: Giga Impact
tmHm.description: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

tmHm.name: Avalanche
tmHm.description: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

tmHm.name: Captivate
tmHm.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

tmHm.name: Sleep Talk
tmHm.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

tmHm.name: Natural Gift
tmHm.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

tmHm.name: Swagger
tmHm.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

tmHm.name: Substitute
tmHm.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

tmHm.name: Strength
tmHm.description: The foe is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move boulders.

tmHm.name: Rock Smash
tmHm.description: The user slugs the foe with a shattering punch. It can also smash cracked boulders.

tutor.name: Mud-Slap
tutor.description: The user hurls mud in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

tutor.name: Icy Wind
tutor.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

tutor.name: Aqua Tail
tutor.description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

tutor.name: Snore
tutor.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

tutor.name: Helping Hand
tutor.description: A move that boosts the power of the ally’s attack in a Double Battle.

tutor.name: Signal Beam
tutor.description: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. It may also confuse the target.

tutor.name: Last Resort
tutor.description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

tutor.name: Swift
tutor.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the foe. This attack never misses.
